{{Quote|They've got enough to deal with.<br/>Choice between dark and light. Coming to grips with killing a parent. Knowing hopes might get raised only to be dashed.<br/>Hormones.<br/>And hormones. I take it back. They've got more than enough to deal with.|[[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], on [[Ben Skywalker]] and [[Vestara Khai]]|<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Ascension">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Ascension]]''</ref>}}
[[Pheromone/Legends|Pheromones]] were an example of a biological '''hormone'''. [[Kira Carsen]] frequently referred to [[Archiban Frodrick Kimble|Doc]] as a walking hormone due to his near-constant flirting. 

In [[44 ABY]], hormones were briefly discussed by [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] while discussing Skywalker's [[Ben Skywalker|adolescent son's]] budding relationship with former [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Sith]] [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] [[Vestara Khai]].
